prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 39.7 °C (28% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.1 °C (23% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 46.4 °C (19% above healthy). Thermal dissipation is sub-optimal, allowing gradual temperature elevation during continuous load cycles.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.87 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.37 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (within 2% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.4 % (4% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.5 bar (within 1% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
